description: Hand-authored synthetic consulate appointment portal: two fictional-data consulates in Chicago (German and French), twelve slots across 2026-2027, one past appointment held with a complete visa file, one upcoming booked appointment and two document checklists, for reproducible acceptance, not a benchmark task.

sources.description: Hand-authored synthetic records; no external collection.

transformations: Normalized timestamps with the consulate's local UTC offset; account and object IDs declared in the binding.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation and reuse permissions.
